newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares in Japan financial sector bounce back.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Japan financial sector bounce back.

text.p: Shares in the financial sector rose on active buying back on Monday morning after being hit hard last week.
As of 0037 GMT Sakura Bank Ltd had gained 13 yen to 663 yen, on turnover of 3.885 million shares. Its trading volume was the largest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Shares in Fuji Bank Ltd were flat at 1,410 yen, after rising to 1,480 yen. The 2.279 million shares traded represented the third-heaviest volume on the first section.
In the brokerage sector, Nomura Securities Co Ltd gained 60 yen to 1,550 yen at 0044 GMT, on volume of 1.019 million shares.
Daiwa Securities Co Ltd rose 26 yen to 963 yen. Volume was 1.224 million shares.
